description: Owner analytics for an embed: list the visits (sessions) to one embed, newest first by default. Each session has its start and last activity time, whether it is still live, total and active time, media opened, time watched, questions asked, the viewer's email and name when they identified themselves, their country, browser, device and referrer, campaign tags, and whether it was a bot. Returns sessions with totalCount, page and pageSize. Use get_embed_session with a session's _id for its full timeline.

country.description: Exact country name as shown in a session's client.country

embedId.description: The embed's _id (24 hex characters), as returned by create_embed or check_embed

from.description: Only sessions started on or after this time (ISO 8601 date)

includeLegacy.description: Also include visits recorded before session tracking started (default false)

includeOwner.description: Include sessions from people signed in to your own Speak AI workspace (default false)

mediaId.description: Only sessions that opened this media file

search.description: Match a viewer email (any part) or the start of a visitorId

to.description: Only sessions started on or before this time (ISO 8601 date)

traffic.description: people leaves out bots, bots shows only bots (default all)

viewer.description: identified keeps viewers who gave their email, anonymous keeps the rest (default all)

viewerId.description: Only sessions of one identified viewer (viewerId from a session)

visitorId.description: Only sessions from one browser (visitorId from a session)

name: list_embed_sessions

data.description: Response payload from the Speak AI API

title: List Embed Sessions
